outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a single macroscopic intestine image per genotype. The caption does not state how many mice were examined or that this image is representative of a stated number of animals, so neither the number nor type of replicates is reported.

Panel B shows representative H&E-stained sections per genotype, but the caption gives no indication of how many mice/sections were examined or that the images represent a larger sample, so replicate number and type are not reported.
The caption explicitly states the sample size range and specifies it refers to mice per genotype, satisfying both number and type of replicate reporting.
The Kaplan–Meier survival panel caption explicitly reports the sample size range and specifies it refers to mice per genotype.

Panel E includes a quantification bar graph (with error bars) of GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels, implying repeated measurements, but the caption does not state the number of replicates or what they represent (e.g., independent pulldown experiments or number of animals).
Panel F shows representative immunohistochemistry images per genotype/marker without any statement of how many mice or sections were analysed, so neither replicate number nor type is reported.

Panel G presents a quantified 'Relative expression' bar graph with error bars and significance markers derived from immunoblotting/zymography data, but the caption does not state the number of replicates (e.g., independent experiments or animals) or their type.
